rubric_items.reason: Every acceptance criterion 1-8 maps to REQ-1..REQ-18; the user-story motivation, auto-refresh and data path are listed under Out of scope with reasons.
Most REQs are single checkable behaviours; REQ-12 bundles the Fully booked label with the rule that doctors whose slots all passed stay listed.
Known items cite ticket lines, baseline or IDE answers A-01/A-02; product claims C1-C10 check out against the code and PRD.
No clash between ticket and baseline found; slot counting follows the shared slotStates rule, consistent with the booking rules and the hospital time zone constraint.
Two real gaps were asked in the IDE with concrete options and defaults; no needless questions remain open.
Plain wording; glossary terms (Dashboard, Slot, Period, Inactive, Tile) used consistently.

findings.text: REQ-12 is compound: it holds the Fully booked label (ticket criterion 4) and a separate listing rule from A-01 that a doctor whose slots today have all passed stays listed. These are two checks a tester would run separately.
